findings.title: Cell-subdivision candidate estimate overstates the reduction
findings.description: The stated estimate that `S=3` reduces candidates from 45,000 to about 5,000 counts the lower occupancy per cell but not the larger scan: the kernel visits 49 cells rather than 9. Under the document’s own occupancy assumptions, that is about `49 × (5000/9) ≈ 27,200` candidates, not 5,000. With counter-gating, that implies roughly a 1.65× reduction rather than the suggested 9×. Correct the estimate and explain what measured scan behavior is expected to make subdivision worthwhile.

findings.title: Verification commands cannot isolate the interventions
findings.description: The “baseline” and “early exit only” commands both run `S=1`, and the “cell subdivision only” and “both interventions” commands both run `S=3`. No option disables early exit or restores counter-gating, so the walkthrough cannot produce the stated comparisons. Define how to run the counter-gated variant or explicitly use a recorded slice 145 baseline artifact and revise the experiment descriptions accordingly.

findings.title: Cell size must account for per-profile query radii
findings.description: Slice 145 describes per-profile `query_radius` values and sets cell size from `max_query_radius`. This design instead says `cell_size = query_radius / S` without specifying that the configured radius is the maximum across profiles. If any profile’s radius exceeds the value used to size the cells, scanning only `±S` cells can omit valid neighbors and violate the behavioral-fidelity goal. Define the subdivision using the maximum supported radius, or specify a per-agent scan bound.

findings.title: The preserved A7 seam is bypassed at the cap
findings.description: Option A checks the cap and breaks before calling `get_neighbors_first_k`, then describes the seam as unreachable after the break. That prevents a future distance-ranked selector from examining candidates after the first `k` have been accepted, despite the slice plan assigning this work to the existing neighbor-selection seam and slice 145’s A7 requirement to preserve it as a swap point. Keep the seam operational for the planned swap, or revise the claim that this implementation preserves that interface.
